entries.text: v12.6.0 (2026-11-20) Notable changes New features NestFactory.create() infers the application type from the adapter: NestFactory.create(AppModule, new FastifyAdapter()) returns a NestFastifyApplication with no type argument, and the same goes for ExpressAdapter and NodeAdapter. An explicit type argument still works. A custom adapter declares its application type as the fourth type argument of AbstractHttpAdapter – #18623 WsAdapter takes gracefulShutdown (false by default) and gracePeriod (10,000 ms by default). With gracefulShutdown, closing the application stops accepting connections (an upgrade on a server shared with the HTTP adapter gets a 503), ignores new messages, waits up to gracePeriod for message handlers and pending replies, and closes each socket with code 1001 – #18589 gRPC server: gracePeriod (10,000 ms by default) for gracefulShutdown – #18566 New defaults and behaviour changes gRPC server with gracefulShutdown: closing used to wait for the calls in progress with no limit; calls still running after gracePeriod are now cancelled. Raise gracePeriod for long-running streams – #18566 A custom parameter decorator that gives the handler the response object now passes it as it is, and no pipe runs on it, as with @Res(), whatever the adapter. On Fastify such a handler used to never run – #18600 A method that overrides a @Res({ passthrough: true }) handler with a plain @Res() no longer inherits passthrough – #18617 DiscoveryService finds a class that extends a class dec

entries.text: v12.5.0 (2026-11-12) Notable changes New options WsAdapter takes maxPayload, the largest message a client may send (1 MB by default, was 100 MB; a gateway's own maxPayload takes precedence, 0 lifts the limit); a larger message closes the connection with code 1009 – 109e52cd9b IoAdapter takes maxWaitingMessages, the number of a client's messages of one event that may wait beyond those being handled (10,000 by default; Infinity lifts it) – c98b5f782e TCP server: maxConcurrentMessages (1000 per connection by default; 0 lifts it) – 42c619cd69 gRPC server: maxPendingResponses (1000 by default; 0 disables), after which a streaming call whose client leaves its responses unread fails with RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED – ce6d44d858 Redis server: maxWildcardChannelLength (1024 characters by default; 0 disables) for requests matched through a wildcard subscription – 074dcf7c60 RabbitMQ: maxMessageSize (16 MiB by default) for messages and replies decoded as JSON – da6b3fc5bc @nestjs/platform-fastify: multipart limits.jsonFieldsSize (1 MiB by default) for the fields of a request sent as application/json – 958316696f New defaults and behaviour changes TCP: maxBufferSize defaults to 16 Mi characters (was 128 Mi), in both directions – 55da0b0d33 – and now applies to each packet rather than to everything received in one read, so a burst of small packets no longer closes the connection (#18502) – ce285e6ad3 TCP server: an empty or unset host now listens on localhost; set host: '0.0.0.0' (or '::') to list
